relationships.description: The external documentation link supplements the API's title, version and description metadata by pointing readers to fuller off-document material about the same API as a whole.
relationships.evidence: An OpenAPI file whose root 'externalDocs' URL and the 'info' block (e.g. its description or termsOfService) refer to the same hosted API documentation site.

relationships.description: The external documentation provides readers of the whole API description with a link to guides or reference material hosted outside the spec file.
relationships.evidence: The openapi.yaml/json root object contains an 'externalDocs' field whose 'url' points to the hosted documentation.

relationships.description: The external documentation gives consumers of a specific method-path interaction a link to detailed usage guidance for that endpoint beyond its inline summary and description.
relationships.evidence: An operation object under paths/{path}/{method} declares an 'externalDocs' field, or a framework annotation such as @ExternalDocumentation is placed on the controller action.

relationships.description: The external documentation points users of a data shape to off-spec explanation of its fields, semantics or the standard it follows.
relationships.evidence: A schema under components/schemas or an inline schema contains an 'externalDocs' object, or a model class carries an annotation that generates that field.

notes: associated-with to Info is questionable: the OpenAPI spec does not let externalDocs attach to Info; it attaches to the root document, which already has a serves relationship, so this link is redundant. Tag, a valid attachment point, has no relationship and appears to be missing.
